verdict.rationale: Zoho Invoice is an invoicing and billing SaaS, not an AI agent or AI host. Plugging in MCP servers so the product itself consumes their tools is an MCP-client role that falls outside this product category. Nothing in the evidence shows an in-product AI assistant or agent that could act as an MCP client, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
